title: Head-On Collision Near Kaziranga National Park in Assam Kills at Least 26
dek: A passenger minibus and a container truck collided on National Highway 715 in Golaghat district on Friday; many of the dead were college students, police said.
author: Meridian Newsroom

keyPoints: At least 26 people died and 20 were injured when a passenger minibus collided head-on with a container truck near Kaziranga National Park, Golaghat district, on Friday, PTI reported.

Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced ex gratia payments of Rs 2 lakh to the family of each person killed and Rs 50,000 to each injured person, PTI reported.
body:
At least 26 people were killed and 20 injured on Friday when a passenger minibus collided head-on with a container truck on National Highway 715 near Kaziranga National Park in Assam’s Golaghat district, [PTI reported](https://tribuneindia.com/news/india/26-die-in-assam-bus-truck-collision). The crash happened at Rangajan, near the Hathikuli tea estate in the Kohora range.

## The victims and the toll

Police said two of the dead were women and many were college students returning from their classes, PTI reported. An executive magistrate in Golaghat told reporters that the death toll could rise. [NDTV reported](https://ndtv.com/india-news/driver-may-have-suffered-stroke-before-kaziranga-crash-that-killed-26-assam-chief-minister-himanta-biswa-sarma-12325999) on Saturday that 16 people were still being treated, around a dozen of them in intensive care units. [India Today reported](https://www.indiatoday.in/india/story/several-feared-dead-after-truck-hits-mini-bus-in-assams-kaziranga-rescue-ops-underway-3038208-2026-11-13) that most of the victims were reportedly students.

## How the crash unfolded

The minibus was travelling from Golaghat to Nagaon, while the container truck was heading toward Upper Assam, police said, according to PTI. Golaghat Senior Superintendent of Police Swapnaneel Deka said senior civil and police officials rushed to the scene, and the exact number of people on the minibus was not immediately known. Nine ambulances ferried the injured, and doctors referred 20 people to Jorhat for advanced treatment, an official told PTI.

## What the chief minister has said

Chief Minister Sarma visited the site on Saturday. NDTV reported that he said dashcam footage from the truck suggested the minibus suddenly changed direction into the truck’s path. He said the driver may have suffered a stroke or may have been under the influence of alcohol, and that investigators were examining both explanations. The state government will conduct a detailed post-mortem examination of the driver. Sarma also said the speed limit on most stretches of Kaziranga is 40 km/h, and that authorities would enforce the restrictions strictly.

## Compensation

Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced ex gratia payments of Rs 2 lakh to each family of a person killed and Rs 50,000 to each injured person, PTI reported. NDTV reported that Sarma announced Rs 9 lakh for the family of each victim who died, with Rs 7 lakh from the state government and Rs 2 lakh from the Centre.

Meridian has not confirmed the cause of the crash. The toll in this story comes from PTI and Indian outlets; Meridian did not find an AP or Reuters report of the crash in the sources reviewed.
